description: Standing jobs: cancel a job owned by the calling wallet. Future runs stop at once and a run already in flight is discarded. Past run records stay readable through wever_schedule-status. Cancelling an ended job returns its final state. POST /api/schedule-cancel. Standing jobs check and report: they run read-and-report Wever tools only and never move money, place orders or change state. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Every call carries X-Wever-Wallet-Proof bound to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route; a paid call adds Payment-Signature from the same wallet. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/standing-jobs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/standing-jobs/.

job_id.description: Standing job identifier returned at creation.
